reported: Late-game turn time ("the crash can also come from underoptimized code"), found while profiling a Marathon snapshot at turn 400; save/reload divergence found with the harness reload check

root_causes.building_value: AI_buildingValueThreshold called canTrain(UnitCombatTypes) (a scan over all unit classes) for every unit combat type and building before testing whether the building gives that combat type experience
root_causes.best_unit: AI_bestUnitAI called canTrain and AI_unitValue twice per unit (two passes with identical answers)
root_causes.border_danger: AI_getAnyPlotDanger set unsaved border-danger flags for the enemy team and on the enemy plot without knowing they held; cleared only on war, peace or a nearby owner change, so the running game kept stale flags that a reloaded game did not have

measured.position: Mediterranean Marathon, turn-400 snapshot (342 cities, about 1,800 units), three turns, profiling build, equal load
measured.reload_check: snapshot at turn 150 (Mediterranean, seed 7) reloaded and played 12 turns; snapshot at turn 200 (Earth 12, seed 2) reloaded and played 25 turns: telemetry identical to the running game (with patch 0014's attitude fix)
